tools.name: sun_times
tools.description: Get sunrise, sunset, solar noon, twilight times, and day length for any location on a given date, in local time. Useful for questions like 'what time is sunset in Lisbon tonight', 'how long is daylight in Reykjavik in December', or planning outdoor activities around daylight.

location.description: City name, optionally with country/region for disambiguation, e.g. 'Lisbon', 'Norfolk, UK', 'Kyoto, Japan'

date.description: Date to check, as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-12-21'). Defaults to today if omitted. You can also pass 'today' or 'tomorrow'.
